name: Nights Like This by Dondre Green
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Nights Like This recipe is made for the nights we hope to never forget. It emphasizes the illuminated parts of the image in low-light and night scenes, while making shadow areas darker, creating a nice contrast to your image. This recipe gives a cinematic feel to night portraits and also works magic when there are colorful light sources involved in the background at night.
